name: vonbenzon2022
role: literature hydrodynamic coefficient set B (grader / hidden-world side only; never ship agent-side)
convention: diagonal Fossen coefficients about the CG, body axes, positive magnitudes; invariant under FRD<->FLU

units.damping_linear: N s/m x3, N m s/rad x3
units.damping_quadratic: N s^2/m^2 x3, N m s^2/rad^2 x3

identified_vehicle.note: added mass computed with DNV empirical formulae (AddedMassCoef.m), damping identified

provenance: von Benzon et al. (2022) J. Mar. Sci. Eng. 10(12):1898, Table A1. Values read directly from the authors' MATLAB package Parameters/Robots.mat (phase-1 note R2 section 11 row 1); cross-checked against Umiusi estimate_hydro.py and OceanScale vehicles/bluerov2.py transcriptions (R4 section 6; R4 lists Kp' = 0.189, the .mat has 0.186).
